guide.biology: Some substances get in the way of enzymes and slow the changes they speed up.
guide.rules: Adds breaker activity that diffuses normally and loses 1 % per second. In each cell every enzyme's effective activity becomes activity / (1 + breaker), so breaker 1.0 halves starch, oil and protein conversion there. It does not remove the enzymes. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Add breaker around a Crumbsmith starch patch and watch the sugar haze fade.
